# testdata/raise_ends_handler.txtar's program, run on the targets its records
# only compile: the interpreter, which runs the checked IR and answers a raise
# itself (dispatchRaise), html in a real Chromium, and gtk4.
#
# A raise the boundary catches ends the click: the write ahead of it stays, and
# the write after it, the callee's write after its own raise and the caller's
# write after the call never happen.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

[!gtk4] skip 'gtk4 development libraries required'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

func stop(why string) {
    error.raise(why, "stop")
}

// The two cases keep disjoint state because html's test agent shares one
// page's state across the tests of a component.
component form node {
    var caught = 0
    var before = 0
    var after = 0

    var callCaught = ""
    var callBefore = 0
    var wrote = 0
    var back = 0
    var callAfter = 0

    func check() {
        wrote = wrote + 1
        stop("from check")
        wrote = wrote + 100
    }

    func submit() {
        check()
        back = back + 1
    }

    boundary(@error(e) {
        caught = caught + 1
    }) {
        button #direct(text="Direct", @click {
            before = before + 1
            error.raise("stop", "stop")
            after = after + 1
        })
    }

    boundary(@error(e) {
        callCaught = e.message
    }) {
        button #called(text="Called", @click {
            callBefore = callBefore + 1
            submit()
            callAfter = callAfter + 1
        })
    }
}

func testDirectRaiseEndsHandler(t Test, c form) {
    c.direct.click()
    c.direct.click()
    t.assert(c.caught == 2)
    t.assert(c.before == 2)
    t.assert(c.after == 0)
}

func testCalledRaiseEndsHandler(t Test, c form) {
    c.called.click()
    c.called.click()
    t.assert(c.callCaught == "from check")
    t.assert(c.callBefore == 2)
    t.assert(c.wrote == 2)
    t.assert(c.back == 0)
    t.assert(c.callAfter == 0)
}

window {
    form()
}
-- testrun/gtk4/go/app.sngl/form/1 --
